dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave (falcate) curvature on the posterior edge extending from the dorsal ridge to the terminal apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a moderate pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderate angular steepness of approximately 40 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Low ratio of approximately 0.7:1, indicating a very wide pixel base relative to the vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex melon with a prominent bulbous structural boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Extremely short and robust beak with a high thickness-to-length ratio, showing minimal extension.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Wide obtuse angle measured at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope meets the rostrum base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch is located on the lower trailing edge of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a large, broad-based pectoral fin and a dark dorsal cape contrasting with lighter lateral regions.
